name: singlet_scalability_metacell_construction
title: Metacell construction
description: Partitions single cells into state-homogeneous metacells and writes the cell-to-metacell assignment and per-metacell QC. Use the default metacell2 method for large datasets, seacells when soft memberships are needed, and supercell for quick graph-based coarse-graining. Requires raw UMI counts in layers/counts. Do not use it to call cell types or to test cell-level differential expression, because metacells are aggregates rather than cell types.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Algorithm: metacell2 (published standard), seacells (model-based, soft memberships) or supercell (graph-based).

target_size.description: Target cells per metacell; sets the MetaCell-2 target, the SEACells archetype count round(N/size) or the SuperCell gamma.

split_by.description: Obs column whose values are never mixed within a metacell, such as batch or donor.

label.description: Obs column of expert labels used only for purity QC; labels never influence construction.

seed.description: Random seed for SEACells initialisation and SuperCell approximate sampling; fixes reproducibility.

device.description: Execution device; only seacells uses cuda, and auto selects it only when enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, peak memory and device without constructing metacells.

overwrite.description: Replace existing metacell members instead of failing.

metacell2.description: Options used only when method is metacell2.

min_metacell_size.description: Metacells smaller than this are dissolved into outlier cells.

target_metacell_umis.description: UMI target per metacell, combined with the target size to set the divide-and-conquer pile size.

deviants_max_cell_fraction.description: Maximum fraction of cells that can be flagged as deviant.

seacells.description: Options used only when method is seacells.

n_metacells.description: Number of archetypes; null uses round(N / target_size).

embedding.description: obsm key of the embedding used to build the kernel.

n_neighbors.description: kNN size of the adaptive kernel; the bandwidth uses the neighbour at index n_neighbors // 2.

n_waypoint_eigs.description: Diffusion eigenvectors used for waypoint initialisation.

convergence_epsilon.description: Stop when the reconstruction error falls below this fraction of its initial value.

min_iter.description: Minimum outer iterations before convergence is checked.

graph_construction.description: How the directed kNN graph is symmetrised for the kernel support.

supercell.description: Options used only when method is supercell.

k_knn.description: Number of neighbours in the single-cell graph.

n_pc.description: Principal components used to build the single-cell graph.

n_var_genes.description: Most variable genes used for the principal components.

approx_n.description: Subsample size for approximate mode; null is exact, and documentation suggests approximate mode above 50,000 cells.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, such as obs/metacell. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, target_size, n_cells, n_metacells, size_median, size_iqr, n_dissolved, weighted_purity (null without label), compactness_median, separation_median, seed.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
